Hey guys. Over my course of development I’ve created some repos for Ergo Scala development. 

1 being Edge, which helps simplify and humanify ergo app kit so that it can be better classified and translated from human understandable design to code
2 being ergo-play-boilerplate, a boilerplate for a scala play app that utilizes ErgoAppkit and edge. This boilerplate is set up for scaling in terms of folder and file organization.

Why am I saying this? Well, over time I’ve used edge to built multiple backend projects like exles single lender token, crowdfund, DumDumDum (tweet nft protocol) and have seen it’s effectiveness in helping me build faster (utilizing edge has helped me improve efficiency of crowdfund development by around 4x at least, finished the whole development of it from contract to txs to bots running on servers in around 80 hours if I’m not mistaken). However the current repo is being used only by me and maybe MGpai or Lgd (as I am not a keen fan of doing marketing) and lacks documentation and improvement over time. I think that edge can play a big part in the development ecosystem if it’s being utilized, maintained and improved over time. And ergo-play-boilerplate can give newcomers barebone code to jump into the world of ergo development and get their feet wet super quickly. 

I do not have the time to plan or think out what to do with these however I’m open to receiving ideas and support from developers who are interested to explore, utilize and improve these repos. If interested please reach out or check out the repos below and open issues/tag me for suggestions you have.


These are the repos:
Edge - https://github.com/Ergo-Lend/edge
Ergo-play-boilerplate - https://github.com/kii-dot/ergo-play-boilerplate
